npcs.name: Lord Edric Vale
npcs.description: Noble Patron associated with Vale Manor's receiving hall.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a noble patron and someone will point you to Lord at Vale Manor's receiving hall. At 48, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Lord offers wine before answers, and is rarely without signet he twists when lying politely. Married to Mirelle; affair with Lysa; patron to Mayor. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to place Perrin in a marriage that secures river rights. What keeps them careful is scandal costing him council influence. To a DM, Lord is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Misplaced a spare signet the same week Mira found one in a cloak hem.

npcs.rumor: Rumor says Lord can tell you anything that happens near Vale Manor's receiving hall—for a price or a kindness.

npcs.appearance: Human; often near Vale Manor's receiving hall; look for signet he twists when lying politely.

To a DM, Lady is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Hired a private listener to watch the orangery path at night.

npcs.name: Cressida Fenn
npcs.description: Court Gossip associated with tea tables and balcony whispers.
npcs.biography: Cressida Fenn works as a court gossip out of tea tables and balcony whispers, a 33-year-old Half-Elf with more town memory than most council minutes. Cressida laughs softly at secrets she already knew, and is rarely without fan with a hollow rivet for notes. Confidante to Mirelle; plays both sides. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to become the town's indispensable matchmaker of alliances. What keeps them careful is backing the wrong Vale in a house split. To a DM, Cressida is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Sold a rumor about Lysa to Kitty Shade for theater tickets and leverage.

npcs.name: Baron Torvald Ash
npcs.description: Mining Magnate associated with a stone townhouse smelling of ore.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a mining magnate and someone will point you to Baron at a stone townhouse smelling of ore. At 140, this Dwarf has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Baron weighs coins on a pocket scale mid-conversation, and is rarely without nugget pendant from his first profitable shaft. Business rival/partner talks with Edric. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to buy river docking rights from Edric. What keeps them careful is sabotage in the mines blamed on 'adventurers'. To a DM, Baron is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Suspects Orrin's 'spice losses' are cover for ore theft.

npcs.description: Lady-in-Waiting associated with side corridors of Vale Manor.
npcs.biography: Ask around town for a lady-in-waiting and someone will point you to Lysa at side corridors of Vale Manor. At 28, this Human has learned which smiles are currency and which are warnings. Lysa checks over her shoulder before she smiles, and is rarely without locket with a blank painted face. Affair with Edric; client of Hedda. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to leave town with enough coin to vanish kindly. What keeps them careful is Mirelle's private listener. To a DM, Lysa is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Tried to pawn Edric's gift ring; Lina almost recognized the crest.

npcs.description: Heir Apparent associated with fencing yards and tavern galleries.
npcs.biography: Perrin Vale works as a heir apparent out of fencing yards and tavern galleries, a 17-year-old Human with more town memory than most council minutes. Perrin challenges anyone who calls him 'boy', and is rarely without practice rapier with a noble wire wrap. Heir; trained illicitly by Hobb's yard. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to win a real duel that makes minstrels sing. What keeps them careful is being married off before he sees the world. To a DM, Perrin is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Paid Cal for introductions to 'dangerous friends'.

npcs.name: Dame Orla Quince
npcs.description: Salon Patron associated with an old elf-owned townhouse gallery.
npcs.biography: Dame Orla Quince works as a salon patron out of an old elf-owned townhouse gallery, a 260-year-old Elf with more town memory than most council minutes. Dame corrects pronunciation of dead poets, and is rarely without portrait collection with one face turned to the wall. Patron of arts; employs Cressida's gossip. What drives them is simple to name and hard to finish: they want to fund a public theater that outlives gossip. What keeps them careful is mortality fashion among humans rushing her into patronage mistakes. To a DM, Dame is ready to roleplay immediately—useful for favors, local color, or trouble. Commissioned Nessa to sing a satire soft enough to sting Edric.
